item.title: The new Google Finance is coming out of beta this week, rolling out globally today with new features and capabilities. 🟢 With portfolios, you’ll b...
item.description:
The new Google Finance is coming out of beta this week, rolling out globally today with new features and capabilities.
🟢 With portfolios, you’ll be able to view your performance data and get helpful insights on your investments. Your existing Google Finance portfolios will be available automatically — or you can create a new one by uploading spreadsheets, files or even screenshots of your holdings.
🟢 Google Finance can now keep you updated on market intel and deliver a custom briefing on your preferred schedule. Simply describe a task like, “Send me a daily pre-market briefing analyzing significant overnight moves across major cryptocurrencies.” When your update is ready, you’ll receive a notification through the Google app for Android or iOS, as well as in the research panel in Google Finance on the web. This feature is also rolling out globally today.
🟢 Keep up with the market on the go with the new Google Finance app for Android. You’ll be able to access your watchlist, real-time data, a live financial news feed and the AI research tool. Even more features and an iOS app are coming soon.
Learn more about Google Finance → goo.gle/3QJcSxZ

item.title: Today we’re introducing study notebooks in the Gemini App 📓✨ a new, interactive space designed to help turn your natural curiosity into deeper co...
item.description:
Today we’re introducing study notebooks in the Gemini App 📓✨ a new, interactive space designed to help turn your natural curiosity into deeper comprehension.
Study notebooks offer an engaging way to test your knowledge and retain information on anything you’re trying to learn more about. By uploading your materials, Gemini can generate custom diagnostic quizzes, bite-sized practice modules and a dashboard that tracks your focus areas and progress over time.
💡 To get started, just select “New notebook” in the Gemini app side panel, and hit “Study” then upload your course materials.
Study notebooks also sync your uploaded sources and past chats with NotebookLM so you can seamlessly continue learning, ask questions about your course materials, and create flashcards, infographics and more.
We believe access to helpful learning tools should be available to everyone — because expensive prep courses shouldn't be the barrier between you and a great score. You can already prep for the SAT, JEE and NEET just by chatting with the Gemini app (try asking, "I want to study for the SAT”). And starting today, SAT prep is officially available in study notebooks, too.
We're also bringing JEE and NEET to study notebooks soon, and expanding both standard chats and study notebooks to include the ENEM, ACT and GRE this summer. 📚
Study notebooks are available at no-cost and rolling out globally on the web in every region and language the Gemini app supports, with availability on mobile and for school-issued accounts (including for users under 18) coming later this summer.
Learn more → goo.gle/4gDQnVA

item.title: 𝗖𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗲𝘀 𝗟𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟲 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗧𝘂𝗯𝗲 & 𝗚𝗼𝗼𝗴𝗹𝗲: 𝗠𝘆 𝗳...
item.description:
𝗖𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗲𝘀 𝗟𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟲 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗧𝘂𝗯𝗲 & 𝗚𝗼𝗼𝗴𝗹𝗲: 𝗠𝘆 𝗳𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝗖𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗲𝘀 𝗟𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀! ❤️🔥
This year was my very first Cannes Lions. And I had the opportunity to experience it alongside some of my favorite tech companies like GoogleGoogle & YouTube.
Over the next few posts, I’ll take you behind the scenes and share some of the biggest conversations shaping the future of technology, AI, marketing and creativity!
One theme stood out above all:
𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗖𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗼𝗿 𝗘𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗼𝗺𝘆 𝗶𝘀 𝗯𝗲𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗼𝘀𝘁 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗯𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗺𝗼𝗱𝗲𝗹𝘀 𝗼𝗳 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝘁𝗶𝗺𝗲.
Twenty years after a simple 19-second video (“Me at the Zoo”), creators are no longer just entertainers. They’re entrepreneurs, media companies, cultural drivers & increasingly… they’re strategic business partners.
A few things that really stuck with me:
☑️ More than 1 billion hours of YouTube are watched on TVs every single day. More & more people watch it like TV!! For more than half of YouTube’s Top 100 channels, television is now their biggest screen.
☑️ Google announced new Gemini-powered Creator Insights, helping brands identify trends, understand creator performance more & build effective creator campaigns!
The message couldn’t have been clearer:
𝗔𝗜 𝗶𝘀 𝗰𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗵𝗼𝘄 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗶𝘀 𝗰𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗱. 𝗖𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗰𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗵𝗼𝘄 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗻𝗶𝗲𝘀 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗺𝘂𝗻𝗶𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗲.
One of my favorite moments was spending time with the YouTube Creator team. I had the chance to meet Ina, learn more about how YouTube supports creators, receive valuable feedback on my own profile & exchange ideas about where the creator ecosystem is heading.
I also joined Google’s AI & Creativity sessions at Google Beach and met the wonderful Yonca, EMEA Lead at Google Marketing. We spoke about how creator partnerships are becoming increasingly important – not only for consumer brands, but also for enterprise technology companies.
So I’m incredibly proud to be the face of Google’s AI Business campaign in Germany & it reinforced something I’ve been observing for years:
𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗼𝗹𝗼𝗴𝘆 𝗻𝗼 𝗹𝗼𝗻𝗴𝗲𝗿 𝘀𝗽𝗲𝗮𝗸𝘀 𝗼𝗻𝗹𝘆 𝘁𝗵𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗴𝗵 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝘁𝘀. 𝗜𝘁 𝘀𝗽𝗲𝗮𝗸𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗴𝗵 𝘁𝗿𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝗽𝗲𝗼𝗽𝗹𝗲! ❤️🔥🦾
And that’s exactly why we’re seeing more companies investing in creators – not as one-off influencers, but as long-term strategic partners who can translate complex innovation into stories that people actually care about.
The NVIDIA conference in Paris last year made it obvious: 20 out of 30 invited influencers were LinkedIn creators!!
So do how is your technology company already working with creators? What is your approach?

item.title: In a new policy paper released today, Kent Walker shares how a pragmatic approach to AI governance in America can help ensure that everyone benefits f...
item.description:
In a new policy paper released today, Kent Walker shares how a pragmatic approach to AI governance in America can help ensure that everyone benefits from AI. Learn more ⬇️While the promise and pace of AI are remarkable, the debate over AI governance is at a deadlock, with some calling for heavy regulation and others pushing for little or none to maximize innovation.
In a new policy paper released today, we suggest a middle way—one designed specifically for the realities of both frontier models and widely-deployed AI applications.
See how the right governance frameworks can help us capture AI’s massive potential without slowing down innovation. → https://lnkd.in/eEpM2Uxv
